Shape Your Role and Make an Impact Join a dynamic environment where you can take ownership, drive change, and continuously embrace new challenges. We’re looking for dedicated and highly motivated individuals who thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy collaborating across different areas of the organisation.

WHO WE ARE At Trustly, we're building a smarter, faster, and more secure financial future by revolutionizing the world of payments. As a global leader in Open Banking Payments, we are establishing Pay by Bank as the new standard at checkout, providing unparalleled freedom, speed, and ease to millions of consumers and merchants worldwide. Our Ambition: To build the world's most disruptive payment network and redefine what the payment experience should feel like. Trustly is a global team of innovators, collaborators, and doers. If you are driven by a strong sense of purpose and thrive in a dynamic, entrepreneurial, and high growth environment, join us and be part of a team that's transforming the way the world pays. ABOUT THE AI TRANSFORMATION TEAM The AI Transformation team sits at the intersection of technology, product, and people, and is accountable for the operating leverage Trustly gains from making its processes and workflows AI native. The team partners with Customer Operations, Finance, Legal, People, and Go-to-Market to find the workflows where AI changes the economics, redesigns them, and proves the result in cost, cycle time, and reclaimed capacity. Every redesign carries a documented baseline and a figure Finance has validated. ABOUT THE ROLE As AI Operations Transformation Lead on the AI Transformation team, you'll take business workflows across Trustly and rebuild them around AI. You'll work with teams to understand how work gets done today, get clear requirements from the people who do it, and then build the new workflow yourself in Claude and the tools around it. You already use Claude every day and know how far it can be pushed. This is a hands-on operations generalist role. You'll rotate through Trustly's highest priority areas over time, so the problems will keep changing. One month you might be scoping a Finance process with three stakeholders who disagree. The next you're building and testing a Claude workflow for a Customer Operations queue. Every project helps build and enable AI workflows to create an AI-Native Trustly. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Lead the negotiation, drafting, and review of large, complex commercial agreements with merchants, partners, and financial institutions, including payment processing agreements, merchant services agreements, API agreement, IP licences, data processing agreements, procurement agreements, and third-party provider (TPP) relationships. - Draft, review, and negotiate consumer terms and conditions, privacy policies, and other consumer-facing legal documentation in compliance with EU and UK consumer protection regulations. - Demonstrate strong expertise in working from counterparty's terms and templates, efficiently identifying and negotiating key commercial and legal issues to close deals quickly whilst protecting Trustly's interests. - Proactively manage and lead negotiations and build strong alliances with our commercial team in order to do so, managing multiple high-priority negotiations simultaneously with a focus on getting deals across the line. - Partner closely with the Sales team to ensure alignment on negotiation strategy and present a unified voice to external parties, whilst maintaining appropriate independence to push back on Trustly's firm redlines when necessary. - Quickly understand Trustly's payment products, technology platform, and integration methods to provide informed, practical legal advice that accounts for technical realities and business objectives. - Advise product, marketing, and business teams on consumer protection requirements, marketing and advertising regulations, and regulatory compliance for consumer-facing initiatives, reviewing and approving consumer communications and marketing materials. - Partner with Privacy and Compliance teams to ensure consumer-facing products and services meet data protection and privacy requirements, including consent management, transparency obligations, and data subject rights. -
